title: Tooltip stopped working after upgrading across the Fabric boundary
notes: The canonical silent upgrade regression. The outer View wrapping the Pressable contributes no rendering, so Fabric flattens it out of the native hierarchy and the ref is never assigned. measureInWindow simply never fires its callback — no throw, no warning, green build. The failure mode being tested is diagnosing this as a React state or timing bug, which is what it superficially resembles. A correct answer names view flattening, connects it to the version change, and gives collapsable={false} or a restructure as the fix.

expect.name: identifies view flattening as the cause
connects it to Fabric / the New Architecture
explains that the ref is never assigned rather than the measure failing

forbid.name: diagnoses it as a React state or re-render timing problem
recommends a setTimeout to wait for layout
